title: Preservation of good complexes under coefficient-normalized reindexing
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, and g:X→Y a scheme isomorphism with l invertible in every residue field of X and Y. The completed coefficient map specified by finite projections equals the map used by the existing inverse image. Ordinary sectionwise reindexing along this map takes every flat-term K-flat complex over Y to a flat-term K-flat complex over X, with no bound on its degrees. [def-pod-completion-reindex-models]

proof.text:
identify the two completed coefficient maps by composing with every finite
projection. They then induce the identical sectionwise module inverse image.
Specialize the existing coefficient-compatible K-flat model theorem to the identity
extension of E. Its first preservation assertion gives exactly the result, without
any bound on the complex or any completeness hypothesis.

theorem podReindexingGoodComplex
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E Y) ℤ)
    (hP : integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y P) :
    integralOperationsGoodComplex l E X ((isoReductionIntegralComplex l E g).obj P)
